description: Enrich pandas and Polars DataFrames with LLMs: extract structured fields defined by Pydantic models, row by row.
rules: Mark where the row text goes in the prompt with the literal {texto}; without it, the text is appended to the end of the prompt.
The _dataframeit_status and _error_details columns are dropped when no row failed; check that the column exists before filtering on it.
Web search (use_search=True) works only with LangChain providers, not with provider='claude_code' or provider='codex'.
